toothless.linePrev: Beneath his breathing there is cold clay, forever:
toothless.line: A toothless hound-dog choking on a feather
toothless.lineNext: But I took my fishing pole (fearing your fever)
stanza: It was a dark dream, darlin;
The firebreather is beneath the clover
Beneath his breathing there is cold clay, forever:
A toothless hound-dog choking on a feather
